tx:
❗ How to Craft Armour + Amulet - Step by Step Guide 
❗ How to Craft Rings + Weapon - Step by Step Guide
❗ How to Craft 5 mod ES Jewel - Step By Step Guide
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
▸ Helmet
The most important stat on the Helmet is Energy Shield. Try to aim for a helmet with 450+ Energy Shield, ideally 500+.
Second important stat is Critical Strike Chance, get it as high as you can.
Other important thing to get is Resistances. 
▸ Body Armour
As with the Helmet, Energy Shield (and Evasion) are the most important stats. Aim for 1500+ Evasion and 400+ Energy Shield.
Get Resistances to reach the cap
Get Deflection or Faster Start of Energy Shield Recharge as the last stat
▸ Gloves
Since this is a Martial Artist build gloves will be transformed with Way of the Stonefist
Getting gloves with good stats is VERY important. 
Get 2 high Tier flat damage: Added Fire / Lightning / Cold / Phys Damage to Attacks, any x2 combo.
Tier 1 flat Evasion rating or hybrid to boost speed with Hollow Palm Technique.
Cast Speed when on Full life is amazing because it's transformed into Attack Speed on full life. And we're always on Full life.
It's nice to have Dexterity, because when transformed it gives a chance to shoot an extra projectile.
▸ Boots
Deflection Rating is the most important stat, since it helps us boost survivability.
Getting High evasion and ES is very important too, since it boosts both survivability and Attack Speed due to Hollow Palm Technique that we use in the build
Movement Speed is less important, since we mostly move using Tempest Flurry.
▸ Amulet
+3 Melee Levels is very important for damage, since we don't get a lot of extra levels anywhere else. It can be boosted to +4 with Breach craft (see the video above)
if you can get Absent Amulet with free Trinity it will be perfect for the build. 
Defences (Energy Shield and Evasion Rating) are great to have.
Instill Stimulants so it will give you As with Lavianga's Spirits
▸ Belt
Basic belt is Shavronne's Satchel
To recover Shield when using life flask, make sure your flask has INSTANT recovery %.
Mageblood is a decent option too
▸ Ring
Flat Fire, Cold and Lightning are a huge boost to dmg.
❗ONE OF THE RINGS SHOULD HAVE: Leech Physical damage as Mana
Resistances as much as possible, rings are your main source of resistances.
If one of your rings is good enough, use Kalandra's Touch
 ▸Jewels
Use Heart of the Well with x2 Extra Damage + Critical Damage
Time Lost jewels example can be seen above in the gear section. 
For the last Jewel, use a 50% ES Saphire (Craft it using this guide - https://youtu.be/-7ck7nv8XLg)

❗IMPORTANT - Keep Herald of Ash lvl 4 and Tempest Flurry Lvl 5 - level rest of the gems as high as you can. 
 
▸ How we generate POWER CHARGES: 
To generate Power Charges we need to add Living Lightning II + Culmination II + Ailith's Chimes Supports to the Hollow Focus. 
❗ADD GEMS EXACTLY IN THAT ORDER
That way you will generate combo for it (even if you cant see them) and when combo will be expended and you will get Power charges to activate your Charged Staff or use Falling Thunder
On bosses you can also use Killing Palm on Hollow Focus bells before the fight starts to get max charges
❗IMPORTANT - If you are not generating charges - get Lightning Flat Damage on RING or Weapon to Trigger Living Lightning II more often.
         
▸ How to Use Staggering Palm for Clear:
To get the buff from Staggering Palm you will need to use it on Hollow Focus bells a few times every 30s. Look at your left corner to check if the buff is active.
When you are fighting - it is possible to just hold down Staggering Palm button to spam it + auto use it on newly spawning bells to regain the buff. 
 
  
▸ How to use Falling Thunder as a Finisher / Against Rares:
In this Monk build we are attacking at Hyper Speed with Tempest Flurry and natively will generate Power Chargers pretty often. 
Just use Falling Thunder if you encountered Rare monster or boss that you are not melting fast enough but use it ONLY when you have all 5 Charges up. 
Make sure that you critical chance for the skill is always at 83%+ with Pinpoint Critical added so it will be 100% with Daze Passives and Blindside
IMPORTANT - ALWAYS hit the boss at least a few times before using Falling Thunder to Daze and Blind it.  
  
▸How to Fix Mana Situation? 
Oisín's Oath inside the Hollow Focus + Leech Physical Damage as Mana on the ring should be enough to fix your mana situation. 
Keeping Tempest Flurry at lvl 5 + using Efficiency II can also help with mana a lot. 
 
▸Which Weapon Set to use? 
Check detailed weapon set explanation in that video - https://youtu.be/kp3ARmzjB2Y
All your skills should be set to Weapon set 1 and Falling Thunder alone to Weapon set 2.

▸How to use Weapon Sets? 
In Hyper speed Monk build you need to use Weapon set 1 for Speed itself, all skills will go there and Weapon Set 2 for Falling Thunder only to hit bosses and rares harder. 
 
▸ How to NOT Get Stunned
You can pick 1 Stun Threshold notable on the way to Abasement or proceed even further down the line if you're still getting stunned
Get "Gain % of Energy Shield  as Stun Threshold" on Jewels
You can also pick stun Threshold as Venom Reward

res.desc:
If you wanna League Start Monk - use this build guide and swap to SPEED ENDGAME later. 
In 0.5 the early leveling for Monk is easier with Spear and Twisters.
To get the Spear + a skill gem early you can create a Huntress and drop Spear + Spear from her into your stash to use at your Monk Character.

tx:
At the Early Lvls just focus on improving your bow and use any pieces of gear you can find, perfectly preparing higher Evasion gear for lvl 22+ Swap. 
Iron Ring with rolled damage can help you with DPS so try to get them at lower lvls.

We are going to start with Spear for smoother experience - to get Spear + gems at lvl 1 - just create a Huntress character and drop both gems + Spear to stash.
Spending Orbs to add sockets to the Whirling Slash or Twister is not recommended. 
 ❗IMPORTANT:
Use following combo to deal proper damage.
x3 Whirling Slash -> Twister -> Repeat
Using Whirling Slash 3 times before twister will allow you to get more wind from a single Twister cast and will improve your dps significantly.
 
Early Game Supports:
First support you get should be Rage I that you will use for Whirling Slash.
After that get Retreat I for Twister.
Full priority: Rage I > Retreat I > Rapid Attacks I > Prolonged Duration I > Magnified Area I
 
Clear:
You can use Whirling Slash to move around and use Twister occasionally to clear monsters.
 
Single target for Bosses and Rares:
 You can use a combo of Parry + Fangs of Frost at bosses to improve your damage, however pretty often it is not even needed. 
Just use Frost Bomb and your usual combo of 3 Whirling's and Twister after.

The starting position for monk lacks damage nodes, so we will need to take Concussive Attack and go to the Blinding Strike to compensate for it. 
After taking it you can move on into the direction of Tenfold Attacks to reach Hollow palm right after that around lvl 23-25.

tx:
During the campaign you can use either full EVASION or Evasion / Energy Shield Hybrid Gear because Attack Speed from Hollow Palm will scale better early on than Crit. 
Your main item to scale it is Body Armour - so try to always have a body armour with maximum amount of Evasion or Evasion / Es for the campaign.

Bosses and Single Target: 
You can use Storm Wave for both - bossing and single target damage. 
However stacking some Rage I with Tempest Bell and Tempest Flurry is still recommended. 
Clearing Packs:
Branching Fissures I support is great for clearing packs. so use at at the Storm Wave

res.desc: If you wanna League Start Monk - use this build guide and swap to SPEED ENDGAME later.

tx:
Body Armour
To boost your attack speed with Hollow Palm Technique, make sure to get an Armour with 1400-1500 Evasion and 500 Energy Shield to not tank your crit chance. 
Other useful stats:
Faster start of Energy Shield Recharge will help us sustain our ES pool. Since we are replacing the Shavronne's Satchel automatic recharge and Convalescence will be the MAIN way to restore our Energy Shield. Grab Recharge and Faster Start wherever you can, it will definitely help you survive better.
 
Helmet
Focus on getting a Helmet with as high Energy Shield as you can, preferable 500.
Apart from that get Crit Chance and Resistances to reach the cap.
 
Belt
For the belt use Shavronne's Satchel + Instant Flask
  
Amulet Instill
To boost our Evasion further we can use Subterfuge Mask. Make sure that your helmet has ~400-500 Energy Shield to get the best results.
If you want damage, take Stormcharged or Overwhelming Strike or Deep Trance

Use Tempest Flurry + Tempest Bell ONLY Against bosses! 
For Storm Wave if you dislike the movement penalty from Deliberation, you can run Rigwald's Ferocity instead.

general.title: Build Overview
tx:
This is IN DEPTH Guide for my Unarmed Hollow Palm Monk Build for 0.5
If you have questions - hit me on Twitch (twitch.tv/ronarray), I will help! 
If you wanna League Start Martial Artist - use this build guide and swap to SPEED later when you farm enough currency. 
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
In 0.5 the Hyper Speed Build is BACK! Now we can use Martial Artist Ascendancy for Monk to boost the build speed and get up to 18+ attacks per second with decent investment like in the good old times. 
For the cheaper versions you can still get 9-12 Attacks as well. 
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
This guide will explain how you can build a Hyper Speed Monk and will cover everything you need to do to setup it from Hollow Palm to required gear.
In the Endgame we are going to utilize Tempest Flurry to FLY  through maps at HYPER SPEED + Staggering Palm which provides great clear with projectiles. Check the video to see how it works. 
We can also use Hollow Focus + Living Lightning II + Culmination II  to generate Power Charges to fuel both -  Charged Staff for even better clear and Falling Thunder to almost one shot bosses. Tech will be explained in the Skill section down Below. 
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
Campaign Rewards
Venom: Stun Threshold
Tattoos: Resistances
Pillars: Global Defense
Shark Fin: 30% Evasion/ES/Armour (Kaoms)
  
❗IMPORTANT - To play Hyper Speed in 0.5 you will need a pretty good gear, if you are on a low budget use Whirling trinity Martial Artist Build to farm currency and swap to the Hyper speed later when you will get Gear or more Currency.

general.title: Skill Gems
tx:
▸ How we generate POWER CHARGES: 
To generate Power Charges we need to add Culmination II + Ailith Chimes Supports to the Wind Dancer. 
That way you will generate combo for it (even if you cant see them) and when any enemy will hit you triggering shockwave from Wind Dancer combo will be expended and you will get MAX Power charges. 
Video with Timestamp for full explanation of the tech - https://youtu.be/V2FWrgtQvB0?si=7PwpYrv33EeCIoVk&t=452 
 
▸ How to Generate POWER Charges on Pinnacle Bosses:
For Pinnacle Bosses you need to swap Culmination II and Ailith's Chimes + Charge Profusion II to Quarterstaff Strike and use it once when you have 20 combos to get your charges up. 
Most of the time you will need to use Quarterstaff Strike at least twice to get 6 Power Charges. 
❗Use Falling Thunder ONLY when you have 6 Power Charges for Maximum Damage
       
▸ How to Use Staggering Palm for Clear:
To get the buff from Staggering Palm you will need to use it a few times every 30s and stun the enemy with it. Look at your left corner to check if the buff is active.
if you are not stunning often enough - add more flat dmg on rings and use skill more often. 
Video with Timestamp for full explanation of the tech - https://youtu.be/V2FWrgtQvB0?si=g9eKedFBQwYXBtfI&t=325  
  
▸ Tempest Flurry Supports and Options (Speed / Mana / Combo):
In this Monk build we have a lot of options for  Tempest Flurry supports. 
In my setup Efficiency II is necessary to fix mana / provide Quality of Life, but if you just want more DMG you can drop it. 
If you are using Rigwald's Ferocity, make sure that you have weapon set 1 ON and NOT Weapon Set 2. That way you will get speed bonus instead of Damage one. 
Rage III can give us 15% MORE Attack speed which is very important to reach hyper speed. 
In some situations Rage III can be replaced since it is NOT providing a bonus when you are at maximum rage. You can swap it to Elemental Armament II for more damage if you generate Rage fast already. 
 
FOR BOSSES you can also replace Efficiency II with Practiced Combo to prepare your finisher faster, but in the most situations it is unnecessary. 
 
▸ Auras Priority / What to do if you don't have enough Spirit:
This build is VERY Flexible in terms of Spirit and Auras since it is Invoker and Lead me through Grace... with good body armour provides A LOT of it. 
If for some reason you don't have enough just drop Precision I,  Clarity I or Clarity II or all of those. 
Priority for the rest of the auras will be:
1. Wind Dancer 
2. Convalescence 
3. Herald of Thunder 
4. Blasphemy 
5. Ghost Dance
  
▸ How to use Falling Thunder as a Finisher / Against Rares:
In this Monk build we are attacking at Hyper Speed with Tempest Flurry and natively will generate 20 Combo VERY fast. So to properly use Falling Thunder you need to add Culmination II and Pinpoint Critical and use it when you have 20 Combo + 6 Power Charges for MAX DMG. 
Make sure that you critical chance for the skill is always at 100% with Pinpoint Critical added.
IMPORTANT - If you are using Ambrosia - make sure that you have 120+ Charges in your Mana Flask. 
 
  
▸  How to Get enough Attributes
Except for your main skills, you DON'T need to get everything else to lvl 20 if you DON'T have enough stats. 

▸ Curse Level for Blasphemy:
For Temporal Chains to work properly make sure that you have at as high as possible (level 18+) so it will be applied to stronger enemies too.
